content.name: Aoife Kearns
profile: Production supervisor with ten years in food manufacturing, the last four running a shift of twenty-two operators on a chilled ready-meals line. Strong on hygiene standards, line efficiency and bringing new starters up to speed quickly.

details: Part-time evening course completed alongside full-time work
Six higher level subjects including biology and home economics

experience.title: Production Supervisor
bullets: Ran the evening shift on the ready-meals line, responsible for output, hygiene sign-off and the safety of twenty-two operators.
Cut average changeover time from thirty-five minutes to nineteen by re-sequencing the product plan with the planning office.
Led the line through two unannounced BRCGS audits with no major non-conformances.
Trained and signed off every new operator on the shift against the standard work instructions.

experience.title: Line Lead
bullets: Ran one of three packing lines, allocating operators and keeping the line fed with packaging and labels.
First point of contact for machine faults, logging each stoppage and calling in maintenance.
Promoted to supervisor after deputising for six months during a long-term absence.

experience.title: General Operative
bullets: Weighed and mixed ingredients to batch sheets on a bakery ingredients line.
Kept the mixing area to the cleaning schedule and completed the daily hygiene records.

certifications: HACCP Level 2 (Food Safety Authority of Ireland approved)
